sloka: आख्याता गृध्र राजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवंगमाः ।संगताः प्रीति संयुक्ता विनेदुः सिंह विक्रमाः ॥४-६४-१॥
transliteration: ākhyātā gṛdhra rājena samutplutya plavaṁgamāḥ ।saṁgatāḥ prīti saṁyuktā vineduḥ siṁha vikramāḥ ॥4-64-1॥

translations.english: Hearing the words spoken by the king of vultures, the highly courageous monkeys assembled together and leaped with joyscreaming.
